data.body:
[P2] Preserve custom completion decisions during reconciliation

Consider three items, `maxConcurrency: 2`, two recorded successes, and `shouldComplete: ({ completedCount }) => completedCount === 1 ? completeBatch() : continueBatch()`. The new guard skips the predicate when the first recorded item settles. After the second settles, the predicate sees only `completedCount === 2`, so item 2 starts even though the same predicate stops the base implementation after the first completion. This can execute unwanted side effects or leave the batch waiting on an unnecessary callback. Custom predicates must be deterministic, but are not required to be monotonic. Evaluate and latch their completion decision while reconciling, defer only returning until all recorded outcomes are collected, and preserve the latched completion reason. Add a regression covering this predicate with two cached successes.
